record.original_question: Does every 4-connected plane triangulation contain a spanning Halin subgraph?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 4.10 Every 4-connected plane triangulation has a spanning Halin subgraph.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A plane triangulation is a simple planar graph embedded in the plane such that every face (including the outer face) is bounded by a triangle. A graph G is k-connected if it has more than k vertices and removing any fewer than k vertices leaves it connected. A Halin graph is a planar graph constructed as follows: take a tree T with at least four vertices, in which no vertex has degree 2, embed T in the plane, and add a cycle through all the leaves of T in the cyclic order determined by the embedding. A spanning subgraph of G is a subgraph that contains every vertex of G.

Determine whether every 4-connected plane triangulation contains a spanning subgraph that is a Halin graph.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture (originally posed by Lovász and Plummer in 1975) has been disproved. Chen, Enomoto, Ozeki, and Tsuchiya (2015) constructed an infinite family of 5-connected (hence 4-connected) plane triangulations with no spanning Halin subgraph; the smallest such example has 512 vertices. Follow-up work ("Plane Triangulations Without a Spanning Halin Subgraph II") provides further counterexamples.

status_evidence.title: Plane Triangulations Without a Spanning Halin Subgraph: Counterexamples to the Lovász–Plummer Conjecture on Halin Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Counterexamples to the Lovász–Plummer conjecture on Halin graphs: an infinite class of 5-connected plane triangulations without a spanning Halin subgraph, smallest with 512 vertices.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture that every 4-connected plane triangulation has a spanning Halin subgraph is false.

status_evidence.title: Plane Triangulations Without a Spanning Halin Subgraph II
status_evidence.snippet: Further counterexamples to the Lovász–Plummer conjecture, providing more 5-connected plane triangulations without spanning Halin subgraphs.
status_evidence.claim: Additional families of counterexamples confirm the conjecture is false.
